content_sections.heading: DLRS Assam Land Record Assistant Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment includes 579 Land Record Assistant vacancies under the amalgamated establishments of District Commissioners' offices in Assam, excluding Sixth Schedule areas. The notification also identifies 16 posts reserved for persons with disabilities and 6 posts for Ex-Servicemen. These reservations are indicated separately and should not be added to the 579 total vacancies.

content_sections.text: Candidates should read both the original notification and the extension notice before applying, as all other recruitment conditions remain unchanged. Official Recruitment Notices: Directorate of Land Records & Surveys, Assam

content_sections.heading: DLRS Assam Land Record Assistant Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must have passed the required RCCC training examination and possess the prescribed computer and typing skills. Candidates must have completed the six-month Recorders Certificate Class Course (RCCC) training at the Assam Survey & Settlement Training Centre, Dakhingaon, Guwahati. They must have been declared proficient in both Survey and Settlement subjects through an official result declared by the Director of Land Records & Surveys etc., Assam. The proficiency requirement must have been fulfilled before the commencement of Government Notification No. LA&A/429557/158 dated 13 August 2026. Candidates must satisfy both the English typing requirement and the prescribed Assamese or Bengali typing requirement. These skills will also be assessed through the selection process.

content_sections.heading: DLRS Assam Land Record Assistant Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must be between 21 and 40 years as on 1 January 2026, subject to the applicable age relaxation provisions for reserved categories. Age will be determined using the Class X or Class XII examination admit card, pass certificate or marksheet issued by a recognized Central or State Board/Council, provided the document clearly mentions the date of birth or age.

content_sections.heading: DLRS Assam Land Record Assistant Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The Land Record Assistant post carries a Pay Band-2 scale of Rs. 14,000 to Rs. 70,000, with Grade Pay of Rs. 6,200 , along with allowances admissible under the rules of the Government of Assam. The notification specifies the pay scale and grade pay but does not provide a separate in-hand salary calculation.

content_sections.heading: DLRS Assam Land Record Assistant Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on a 100-mark examination consisting of an 80-mark objective written test and a 20-mark practical computer skill test, followed by document verification. The written examination will contain objective-type multiple-choice questions, with negative marking of 0.25 marks for each incorrect answer . The 20-mark practical skill test will assess computer proficiency and typing ability in English and Assamese or Bengali. Candidates who qualify in the written examination and are shortlisted by the Selection Board will be called for this test. The final merit list will be prepared using the combined marks obtained in the written examination and skill test, subject to securing the prescribed minimum qualifying marks in both components and satisfying the eligibility requirements during document verification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for DLRS Assam Land Record Assistant Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official application website at https://sebaonline.org . Locate the recruitment application for Land Record Assistant (LRA) under the Directorate of Land Records & Surveys, Assam. Read the application instructions and eligibility conditions carefully. Fill in the prescribed online application form with the required information. Upload a recent passport-size colour photograph, signature and RCCC passed certificate in the sizes and formats specified by the application portal. Review the entered details and uploaded documents before final submission. Submit the online application by 31 October 2026, 5:00 PM . Download or print the completed application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for DLRS Assam Land Record Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload the prescribed photograph, signature and RCCC certificate during the online application process. Candidates shortlisted for document verification must produce the following documents in original, along with self-attested copies, as applicable. Printed copy of the submitted online application form. Class X/Class XII admit card, pass certificate or marksheet showing date of birth. Educational certificates and marksheets from HSLC or equivalent examination onwards. RCCC passed certificate. Valid caste/category certificate, if claiming reservation. Disability certificate issued by the competent authority, if applicable. No Objection Certificate from the respective Head of Department for candidates already in Government service. Declaration Form-A relating to Small Family Norms. Supporting documents for any other claims made in the application. Candidature will remain provisional until verification of eligibility and original documents. False, forged or misleading information may lead to cancellation and further action under applicable law.

faq.question: Q1. What is Assam DLRS Land Record Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Advertisement No. DLR-11013(21)/50/2025/372, dated 19.09.2026, issued by the Directorate of Land Records & Surveys, Assam, for filling 579 vacant posts of Land Record Assistant (LRA) under District Commissioners' offices across Assam (except Sixth Schedule areas).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Assam DLRS Land Record Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 579 total vacancies, distributed across UR, OBC/MOBC, OBC(T), ST(P), ST(H), SC, and EWS categories, with horizontal reservation for Ex-Servicemen (173) and Persons with Disability (16).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Assam DLRS Land Record Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes at 5:00 PM on 31.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply for the Land Record Assistant post?
faq.answer: Only candidates who have already completed the 6-month RCCC (Recorders Certificate Class Course) Training at the Assam Survey & Settlement Training Centre and have been declared proficient in Survey and Settlement subjects prior to 13.08.2026 are eligible - this is not open to candidates without prior RCCC training.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Assam DLRS Land Record Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 40 years of age as on 01.01.2026, with age relaxation for reserved categories as per applicable Government orders.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for Assam DLRS Land Record Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a Written Examination (80 marks, MCQ, with 0.25 negative marking) covering Mathematics, Conventional Survey, and Modern Survey, followed by a Computer Skill Test (20 marks) and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the Land Record Assistant post?
faq.answer: The pay scale is PB-2 (₹14,000–₹70,000) plus Grade Pay of ₹6,200, along with usual allowances admissible under Government of Assam rules.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply online for Assam DLRS Land Record Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply only through https://sebaonline.org, log in, fill the application form, upload the required documents (photo, signature, RCCC certificate), and submit before the closing date.
